shared_elements: carved stone figure with humanlike face
headgear/helmet-like element covering the top of the head
incised hatched or cross-hatched linear texture
justification: Both are stone sculptures of a broadly humanlike figure whose head is capped by a helmet- or headdress-like element enriched with fine incised hatching, and both stack elements vertically from head downwards. The decisive difference is technique and conception: A is a flat-fronted slab carved in shallow low relief with symmetrical frontal emblems (disc, bands), while B is a fully three-dimensional, asymmetrical crouching figure with modelled limbs seen at close range.
